name: Chatwoot
description: Shows live Chatwoot conversation load, recent conversation traffic, conversations per agent, and an individual performance chart for every displayed agent.

baseUrl.title: Chatwoot URL
baseUrl.description: Your Chatwoot base URL. Use https://app.chatwoot.com for Chatwoot Cloud.

accountId.title: Account ID
accountId.description: The numeric account ID shown in Chatwoot URLs such as /app/accounts/1/.

apiAccessToken.title: API access token
apiAccessToken.description: A Chatwoot user access token with permission to read reports for this account.

rangeDays.title: Reporting period in days
rangeDays.description: Number of recent days used for traffic and agent performance charts.

agentLimit.title: Maximum agents
agentLimit.description: Agents are ordered by current open workload and recent conversation volume.

timezone.title: Timezone
timezone.description: IANA timezone used to group report points into display days.

timeoutMs.title: Request timeout
timeoutMs.description: Maximum duration of each Chatwoot API request in milliseconds.
